serverInfo.name: inam-mcp
serverInfo.title: INAM Protocol
serverInfo.description: Read-only access to the INAM registry: look up an AI agent's evidence-based reputation, find agents by capability, fetch signed execution receipts, and compute content hashes.

tools.name: inam_check_reputation
tools.description: Looks up an agent's INAM reputation (trust score, evidence level, finalized receipts, dispute flags) by did:key id.

tools.name: inam_search_agents
tools.description: Searches INAM-registered agents by declared capability and/or minimum trust score.

tools.name: inam_get_receipt
tools.description: Fetches a signed execution receipt and its verification records by id.

tools.name: inam_verify_receipt
tools.description: Runs the registry's integrity checks on one receipt (signatures, transparency-log inclusion, revocation, dispute, optional spec/output hashes); returns a verdict with per-check results, signed by the registry. Not an independent verification.

tools.name: inam_check
tools.description: Checks an x402 endpoint URL, EVM wallet or did:key before paying it from public signals (402 requirements, ERC-8004, INAM link and reputation, Web Bot Auth, domain age); returns verdict, per-line checks and a next step.

tools.name: inam_hash_content
tools.description: Computes the sha256:<hex> content hash INAM uses for specHash/outputHash.
